subject: Remit policy, PO constraints & vendor enrollment (Orion Retail)
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@orionretail.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor registration & PO constraints for Redwood services

Hi Rachel,

We are starting vendor setup for Redwood to pay for the subscription and professional services tied to ORN-423. Procurement needs the vendor enrollment packet completed so we can issue purchase orders. Can you confirm the following so we can proceed?

- Legal name to use on PO and remit (include any separate remit legal entity for EMEA).
- Tax/VAT evidence: for EMEA we need a VAT registration number (EU VAT certificate + EORI if applicable). For US invoices we'll need a W-9.
- Bank remit details: IBAN + BIC for EU transfers or ACH/CTP details for US.
- Invoice requirements: PO number must appear on the invoice header and on each invoice line item; we also accept a PO reference per line (our AP system validates this).
- Split invoices: does Redwood accept split invoices against a single PO (we sometimes require partial invoicing by milestone)?
- Invoice file naming convention and max file size for your uploads.

I've attached our AP onboarding request form and the vendor registration checklist. Ideally we want vendor added to the portal and the account live before the end of the month. Please advise what you need from us (signed forms, sample invoice, bank details) and the secure channel to transmit banking info.

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement
Orion Retail
(555) 312-9987

Attachment: ORION_AP_Onboarding_Request.pdf (packet)

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@orionretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO constraints for Redwood services

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear checklist. We can be onboarded as a vendor; quick answers inline and next steps below.

Key legal/tax info (we will send formal docs):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EMEA remit/legal entity: Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd (we will provide VAT number / EORI in the packet)
- US tax: we can provide completed W-9 via DocuSign or secure SFTP.

Banking / remit: we will provide both IBAN/BIC (for EUR) and ACH routing/acc numbers for USD. Please confirm the secure upload method (your portal vs. DocuSign).

Invoice requirements: we can supply invoices that include PO on header and on each line; our billing system can populate PO_reference and PO_line fields. We support PDF invoices and a CSV line-level export if your AP system prefers structured ingest.

Split/partial invoices: yes — we can issue partial invoices against a single PO. Please note: if you require invoice-level acceptance of each partial invoice we can include milestone IDs to map to your PO lines.

What I'll do next:
- Attach our AP onboarding packet and sample invoice (pdf) for your upload fields and filename convention.
- Loop in Laura (cc'd) who manages portal uploads and field mapping.
- Aditya will be copied for payment-term/early-pay discussions if needed.

If you can confirm whether you require reverse-charge handling for VAT (Orion to account for VAT) or need us to invoice with VAT shown, we'll include the correct VAT treatment on the sample.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remit_csv_template.csv; sample_invoice_with_po.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@orionretail.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO constraints for Redwood services

Hi Sophie — looping in our AP mappings so your portal team has the exact field names. Below is what our billing/export will send and what your portal should expect.

Required invoice fields (exact keys we populate):
- invoice_number (string, max 32 chars)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- currency (ISO-4217)
- total_amount (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal)
- po_number (string) — appears both at invoice header and invoice_line.po_ref
- invoice_line.description (string)
- invoice_line.quantity (decimal)
- invoice_line.unit_price (decimal)
- invoice_line.po_ref (string)  <-- MUST match po_number if invoice line charges against PO

File format & naming: PDF invoices (preferred) plus an optional CSV for line-level reconciliation. File name convention we recommend: ORN-423_Invoice_YYYYMMDD.pdf (portal rejects spaces). Max file size: 10MB.

Remit entity: for EUR wires please use Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd as the remit_to entity and include VAT ID: GB999999999 (we will provide the formal VAT certificate in the packet).

SAML / portal invite: we can be added via vendor invite (email) or you can provide an upload link. If you prefer SAML metadata exchange, send the invite to laura_bennett@redwood.ai and we'll approve the connection.

Early pay / discount fields: if you want to negotiate early-pay discounts, we will populate payment_terms_code and early_pay_discount_pct. If not required, we'll default to standard 30 net terms.

Timeline: if you send the invite or SAML metadata by EOD 12/18 we should be able to complete registration and accept PO-linked invoices by 12/23.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior AP Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remit_csv_template.csv; sample_invoice_with_po.pdf

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@orionretail.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai

- Partial invoices are fine; we'll accept milestone-based partials as long as invoice_line.po_ref matches the PO.

I've uploaded the signed vendor form and the supplier remit file to the secure DocuSign envelope (link below). We prefer banking details sent via DocuSign or our secure portal rather than email.
